summary: Round 2 verification — all five previous findings are addressed. Implementation details (line numbers, private function names, error codes E031-E033, LOC estimates, parser signature) are gone from ACs and risks; AC2/AC3/AC4/AC5/AC6/AC9 now describe contracts and outcomes rather than internal symbols. SOURCE_LABEL/SOURCE_EMOJI scope is dropped (no emoji decision in 'Технические решения'). The 7-day quality gate has an explicit abort path ('не катим в prod, итерируем промпт/глоссарий отдельным PR') in both Risks section and 'Как проверить'. LLM budget is now engine-agnostic, scoped to active LLM_PROVIDER. AC6 explicitly defers the hashtag-mechanism choice to tech-spec while locking the subscriber-visible invariant '#thunted #news'. Feasibility, sizing (M), stack alignment, edge cases — all sound. Spec is ready for tech-spec phase.
